_comment: File library — centralised store for images, logos, and favicons used across the site. Managed via /admin/files. Files live in public/library/ (uploaded) or as external URLs. favicons map { production, preview, admin } → URL from this library or a static path under /. Schema: { files: [{ id, name, url, type, companies, source, addedAt }], favicons: { production, preview, admin } }.
